new_mechanics_defect.verification: ROM-free regression and complete post-fix Agatha comparison; no training update.

next_bounded_decision: Expand varied independent TRAIN battle choices without consulting consumed DEVELOPMENT outcomes, then fit and evaluate on a new independent-origin natural source. Until that gate passes, keep the older frozen control and deny full-player trainer authority.
